papers.title: What is the Fate of Total Hip Arthroplasty (THA) Acetabular Component Orientation When Evaluated in the Standing Position?
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Massachusetts General Hospital, Harvard Medical School, Boston, Massachusetts

corresponding_authors.name: John V. Tiberi
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Massachusetts General Hospital, Harvard Medical School, Boston, Massachusetts

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅关注髋臼杯方向，不涉及股骨柄应力遮挡或微动分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on acetabular component orientation in standing position, with no femoral stem stress shielding, micromotion, or bone-implant interface analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估站立位下全髋关节置换髋臼杯的方向变化。
summary_zh.method: 对患者进行站立位X线测量髋臼杯前倾和外展角。
summary_zh.result: 站立位时髋臼杯方向与仰卧位有显著差异。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the change in acetabular component orientation from supine to standing position in total hip arthroplasty patients.
summary_en.method: Radiographic measurements of acetabular anteversion and abduction angles were taken in standing position.
summary_en.result: Significant differences in acetabular component orientation were found between standing and supine positions.

papers.title: Effects of Obesity on Health Related Quality of Life Following Total Hip Arthroplasty
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Massachusetts General Hospital, Harvard Medical School, Boston, Massachusetts

corresponding_authors.name: Young‐Min Kwon
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Massachusetts General Hospital, Harvard Medical School, Boston, Massachusetts

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅关注肥胖对全髋关节置换术后生活质量的影响，未涉及任何生物力学建模或植入物力学分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical outcomes study with no biomechanical modeling, no stress shielding or micromotion analysis, no FEA, and no implant design or contact mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估肥胖对全髋关节置换术后健康相关生活质量的影响
summary_zh.method: 回顾性队列研究，比较不同BMI组患者术后功能评分
summary_zh.result: 肥胖患者术后生活质量改善程度与非肥胖患者相似
summary_zh.validation: 基于临床患者报告结局指标的统计分析

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the effect of obesity on health-related quality of life after total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A retrospective cohort study comparing postoperative functional scores across BMI groups.
summary_en.result: Obese patients achieved similar improvements in quality of life as non-obese patients.
summary_en.validation: Statistical analysis of patient-reported outcome measures from clinical data.

papers.title: Mild to Moderate Hip OA: Joint Preservation or Total Hip Arthroplasty?
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopaedics, University of Utah, Utah

corresponding_authors.name: Christopher L. Peters
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedics, University of Utah, Utah

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文讨论髋关节骨关节炎的治疗选择，未涉及任何生物力学建模或植入物设计。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical review of treatment strategies for hip OA, with no biomechanical modeling, implant design, FEA, or stress shielding analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较髋关节骨关节炎的保髋手术与全髋置换术的疗效。
summary_zh.method: 文献综述，总结临床证据。
summary_zh.result: 提出基于患者年龄和活动水平的治疗选择建议。

summary_en.motivation: To compare clinical outcomes of joint preservation versus total hip arthroplasty for mild to moderate hip osteoarthritis.
summary_en.method: Narrative review synthesizing existing clinical evidence.
summary_en.result: Recommends treatment selection based on patient age and activity level.
summary_en.validation: No validation; this is a review article.

papers.title: Update vs. upgrade: Modeling with indeterminate multi-class active learning
papers.first_author_affiliation: Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences, 89 Minzhuang Road, Haidian District, Beijing 100093, China

corresponding_authors.name: Shupeng Wang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences, 89 Minzhuang Road, Haidian District, Beijing 100093, China

corresponding_authors.name: Xiaobin Zhu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Beijing Technology and Business University, China 11 Fucheng Road, Haidian District, Beijing 100048, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注主动学习中的类别不确定性，与FEA替代建模或生物力学设计无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling, surrogate modeling, uncertainty quantification, or any biomechanics/implant design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决多类分类中不确定样本的标注效率问题
summary_zh.method: 提出一种基于类别不确定性的主动学习策略
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准数据集上提高了分类性能
summary_zh.validation: 在标准机器学习数据集上验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve labeling efficiency in multi-class classification by selecting the most uncertain samples.
summary_en.method: Proposes an active learning approach that models indeterminate multi-class uncertainty.
summary_en.result: Achieves improved classification performance on several benchmark datasets.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard machine learning benchmark datasets.
